response.sql: WITH film_actor_counts AS (SELECT film_id, COUNT(*) as actor_count FROM film_actor GROUP BY film_id), first_avg AS (SELECT AVG(actor_count) as avg_val FROM film_actor_counts), filtered_first AS (SELECT fac.film_id, fac.actor_count FROM film_actor_counts fac CROSS JOIN first_avg fa WHERE fa.avg_val IS NOT NULL AND fac.actor_count > fa.avg_val), second_avg AS (SELECT AVG(actor_count) as avg_val FROM filtered_first), filtered_second AS (SELECT ff.film_id, ff.actor_count, fa.avg_val as first_avg_val, sa.avg_val as second_avg_val FROM filtered_first ff CROSS JOIN first_avg fa CROSS JOIN second_avg sa WHERE sa.avg_val IS NOT NULL AND ff.actor_count > sa.avg_val) SELECT SUM(actor_count) as total_actor_count, AVG(actor_count - first_avg_val) as avg_excess_over_first, AVG(actor_count - second_avg_val) as avg_excess_over_second FROM filtered_second;
